notes: Shortcuts now show the real program icon. They were all showing the same generic page symbol, which made a row of them useless - asking Windows for the icon of a Start Menu shortcut returns the icon of the shortcut FILE, not of the program…

Shortcuts sit in their own card. Its own border, its own padding and its own spacing, with the tiles centred - a row of buttons sharing the spacing of a list of readings looked like loose furniture rather than a group of things to press.

A web link, which has no icon to read, gets a lettered tile in a colour taken from its own name. Each one differs, and the same link keeps the same colour every time rather than changing on each launch.
The card and its tiles are sized from a single value, so panels larger than the OG widget will show bigger shortcuts without anything being rebuilt.
